name: Lightfoil, Archaic
description: Delicately balanced one-handed lightfoil that can count as Small when beneficial.

name: Lightsaber, Archaic
description: Ancient corded lightsaber powered by a special 600-credit external pack.

name: Crossguard Lightsaber

name: Lightsaber, Dual-Phase
description: Swift-switch lightsaber with an extended mode granting +1 reach but -2 Reflex against adjacent attackers.

name: Dueling Lightsaber
description: Curved-hilt dueling saber granting +1 equipment bonus on one-handed attacks of opportunity.

name: Lightsaber, Great
description: Oversized lightsaber; only Large+ wielders can combine it with feats meant for light weapons/lightsabers.

name: Guard Shoto
description: Defensive lightsaber tonfa granting +2 equipment bonus to Block/Deflect; phrik-laced handles resist lightsaber DR bypass.

name: Lightwhip

name: Long-Handle Lightsaber

name: Lightfoil, Modern
description: Modern one-handed lightfoil that can count as Small when beneficial.

name: Lightsaber Pike
description: Reach lightsaber pike with phrik haft; +1 reach, -2 Block/Deflect, and Long Haft Form can enable a 1d6 haft end.

name: Retrosaber
description: Corded modernized lightsaber that can overcharge to 2d10, then drops to 2d4 for one recovery round.

name: Lightsaber, Short
description: Small shoto lightsaber commonly used by Small Jedi or as an off-hand weapon.

name: Adhesive Grenade
description: Riot-control grenade that can hold targets in place for up to 3 rounds until they win the opposed grapple check.

name: Czerka Adjudicator
description: Concealable slugthrower backup pistol with four shots and a full-round reload.

name: Czerka Adventurer
description: Accurate long-range slugthrower that can be disassembled or reassembled as a move action.

name: Amphistaff
description: Living Yuuzhan Vong weapon with quarterstaff, poisoned spear, reach/Pin/Trip whip, and once-per-day venom-spit forms.

name: ARC-9965 Blaster Rifle
description: Accurate Imperial rifle with a retractable stock and 40-shot pack; each autofire attack consumes 10 shots.

name: Arggarok

name: Ascension Gun
description: Heavy blaster/grappling system; swift-switch to a 30-square tether that lifts or creates a zipline.

name: Blaster Rifle, Assault
description: Accurate military rifle with single-shot/autofire capability and a 50-shot power pack.

name: Atlatl
description: Gungan energy-ball launcher that can also serve as a club; Gungans with simple-weapon proficiency are treated as proficient.

name: Aurial Blaster
description: Sonic exotic pistol that can deafen a hit target for -5 Perception; 50 shots per power pack.

name: Axe
description: Simple legal chopping weapon that can also be thrown.

name: Squib Battering Ram
description: Two-person powered breaching ram for stationary unattended objects; uses four power packs.

name: Bayonet
description: Rifle-mounted spear-like blade that preserves melee threat/AoO after ranged fire; detached it functions as a knife.

name: Black-Powder Pistol
description: Single-shot inaccurate pistol with a full-round reload; trained characters can forage and manufacture ammunition in the field.

name: Blaster Cannon
description: Shoulder-fired area blaster: full/half damage to the target and splash damage to adjacent creatures/objects; 10 shots per power pack.

name: Blaster Carbine
description: Compact rifle that can always make attacks of opportunity; 50 shots per power pack.

name: Blaster Pistol
description: Standard blaster sidearm with 100 shots per power pack.

name: Blaster Rifle
description: Standard military rifle; 50 shots per power pack and optional retractable-stock configuration.

name: Blastsword
description: Adumari dueling weapon that qualifies as a light weapon for Weapon Finesse; uses a power pack.

name: Blaster Pistol, Bluebolt
description: Inaccurate 50-shot pistol with an 8-square stun range; stun attacks consume an extra shot.

name: Bow
description: Bow adds Strength to damage, holds one arrow, reloads as a free action, and uses purchasable arrow quivers.

name: Bowcaster
description: Wookiee exotic ranged weapon; Wookiees with rifle proficiency are treated as proficient; uses quarrel quivers.

name: Bryar Pistol
description: Can be primed with a swift action for +1 weapon die on the next qualifying shot at a cost of 5 shots.

name: Bryar Rifle
description: Rifle that can prime a +1 weapon-die shot for 5 shots; 50-shot rechargeable pack.

name: Carbonite Rifle
description: Stun rifle that also immobilizes targets it moves down the condition track; 20-shot carbonite cartridges.

name: Cesta
description: Gungan stafflike launcher for energy balls; Gungans with simple-weapon proficiency are treated as proficient.

name: Club/Baton
description: Basic bludgeoning club or police baton with no special weapon rule beyond its listed statistics.

name: Combat Gloves
description: Worn gloves add +1 unarmed damage and cannot be disarmed or dropped.

name: Commando Special Rifle
description: Compact Republic commando rifle with single/autofire capability and only 25 shots per power pack.

name: Concealed Dart Launcher
description: Wrist dart launcher with poison-capable or sedative darts, pistol ranges, unrestricted stun range, +5 to conceal, and a 6-dart bundle.

name: Concussion Grenade
description: Contact-detonated 2-square burst grenade using standard full/half area-attack rules.

name: Concussion Rifle
description: Sonic rifle that attacks Fortitude Defense and knocks a hit target prone; 25-shot power pack.

name: Contact Stunner
description: Compact contact weapon granting +5 to Stealth checks to conceal it; uses an energy cell.

name: CR-1 Blast Cannon
description: Blast cannon with pistol ranges: range penalties reduce damage, adjacent targets take +1d8, and distant shots splash.

name: Crossbow
description: Single-bolt inaccurate crossbow requiring a move action to reload.

name: CryoBan Grenade
description: Cryogenic grenade that reduces a target's speed to 2 squares when the attack also beats Fortitude Defense.

name: Darkstick

name: Darter
description: Short-range dart launcher that can deliver poison on damage or fire surveillance taggers.

name: Datadagger

name: Deck Sweeper

name: Gee-Tech 12 Defender Microblaster

name: BlasTech DH-23 Outback Blaster Pistol
description: Durable blaster pistol with Strength 17 and Break DC 20.

name: Dire Sword
description: Large archaic simple sword with no additional special rule.

name: Dire Vibroblade

name: Discblade
description: Zeison Sha thrown blade that trained Force-users can call back after throwing.

name: DX-2 Disruptor Pistol

name: DXR-6 Disruptor Rifle
description: Disruptor rifle lowers effective damage threshold by 5, disintegrates destroyed targets, and fires only every other round.

name: BlasTech DLT-20A "Longbarrel" Blaster Rifle
description: Long-range rifle with a built-in standard targeting scope and +1 equipment bonus to Reflex Defense against disarm attacks.

name: Blaster Carbine, Double-Barreled
description: Inaccurate 50-shot carbine with a swift-action double-shot mode that attacks a 2x2 area, consumes 2 shots, and blocks multi-shot effects.

name: Lightsaber, Double
description: Two-ended lightsaber; with both blades active it is a double weapon and needs two special energy cells.

name: Double-Bladed Sword
description: Simple double sword; attack with both ends as a full-round action at the normal double-weapon penalties.

name: Double Vibroblade
description: Double vibro weapon using two energy cells and the normal full-round double-weapon attack rules.

name: BlasTech DT-12 Heavy Blaster Pistol
description: Heavy blaster with an enlarged trigger grip; powerful but inaccurate at long range.

name: E-Web Missile Launcher

name: E-Web Repeating Blaster
description: Tripod-mounted, autofire-only heavy blaster powered by a generator and normally requiring a second crewman to regulate power.

name: Electronet
description: Grenade-launcher capture net affecting a 2x2 area; hits stun and grab, and trapped targets take repeated stun damage.

name: Electrostaff

name: EMP Grenade

name: Energy Ball
description: Gungan thrown ammunition whose range category changes when hurled by hand, atlatl, or cesta.

name: Energy Lance
description: Mounted energy lance usable one-handed by Ride-trained Medium riders; also fires as a no-stun blaster carbine and works underwater.

name: Entrenching Tool
description: Multipurpose field tool usable as an improvised weapon at only -2, with piercing or slashing damage.

name: BlasTech 500 Riot Gun
description: Riot carbine favoring autofire: -1 single-shot, +2 equipment bonus to autofire, 50 shots.

name: Felucian Skullblade

name: Fira
description: Cortosis Selkath blade that inflicts half its damage again next round when the attack also beats Fortitude Defense.

name: Fire Blade
description: Powered cutting blade that ignores unattended-object DR.

name: SoroSuub Firelance Blaster Rifle
description: Light blaster rifle built around an unusually strong stun setting.

name: Flame Cannon

name: Force Pike

name: Grenade, Frag

name: Garrote

name: Gas Grenade

name: Grenade Launcher

name: Electropole
description: Throwable electrified pike; Gungans with simple-weapon proficiency are proficient with it; uses two energy cells.

name: Blaster Rifle, Heavy Assault

name: Heavy Blaster Cannon

name: Blaster Pistol, Heavy
description: High-powered blaster sidearm with 50 shots per power pack.

name: Blaster Rifle, Heavy

name: Heavy Repeating Blaster
description: Autofire-only heavy blaster; cannot brace without a mount; 20 shots per pack or generator-powered.

name: Heavy Slugthrower Pistol

name: Heavy Sonic Pistol

name: Blaster Rifle, Heavy Variable

name: Blaster Pistol, Hold-Out
description: Concealable palm-sized blaster granting +5 equipment bonus to Stealth checks to conceal it; 6 shots per energy cell.

name: Blaster Carbine, Hunting
description: Inaccurate 50-shot hunting carbine with no autofire; critical hits upgrade its damage dice from d8s to d10s.

name: Incinerator Rifle
description: Twenty-shot rifle that disintegrates any target it kills or destroys.

name: Interchangeable Weapon System
description: Clone commando modular rifle switching as a standard action among rifle, scoped sniper, and anti-armor grenade modes.

name: Ion Carbine
description: Autofire-capable ion carbine; inaccurate at long range and 30 shots per pack.

name: Grenade, Ion

name: Ion Pistol
description: Ion sidearm dealing full ion effects to electronic/cybernetic targets and half damage to ordinary creatures; 30 shots per pack.

name: Ion Rifle
description: Larger ion weapon using ion-pistol effects; 20 shots per power pack.

name: Knife
description: Silent simple melee blade.

name: Light Concussion Missile Launcher
description: Single-shot antivehicle launcher with 2-square splash; -10 against targets smaller than Huge and incompatible with Rapid Shot.

name: Blaster Rifle, Light Repeating
description: Autofire-only rifle with 30 shots per pack or generator power.

name: Lightfoil
description: One-handed dueling lightsaber that can count as Small when beneficial.

name: Lightsaber

name: Mace
description: Basic metal bludgeoning weapon.

name: Magna Caster
description: Quiet accurate magnetic launcher granting +5 to Stealth checks to snipe; uses 10-bolt cases.

name: Massassi Lanvarok

name: Net

name: Neuronic Whip

description: Six-shot 3-square-burst missile launcher with specialized targeting modes, full-round reload, and a carry-assist microrepulsorlift.

name: Power Lance
description: Cheaper melee-only version of the energy lance, intended for mounted cavalry and speeder-bike scouts.

name: Pulse Rifle

name: Pulse-Wave Rifle
description: Pulse-wave rifle gaining +5 damage at point-blank range; 50 shots and no long-range attacks.

name: Quarterstaff
description: Simple double weapon; both ends can be used in a full-round two-weapon attack.

name: Grenade, Radiation
description: Two-square grenade that attacks Fortitude and also exposes targets to Moderate radiation.

name: Rail Detonator Gun
description: Ten-shot explosive-canister rifle with a 1-square splash radius.

name: Razor Bug
description: Accurate Yuuzhan Vong bio-weapon thrown by hand but using simple-weapon ranges rather than thrown-weapon ranges.

name: Crossbow, Repeating

name: Ripper

name: Shockstaff

name: Short Sword

name: Shyarn
description: Cerean magnetic blade that removes Rapid Strike's attack penalty.

name: Siang Lance
description: One-handed blaster/bayonet weapon that can make attacks of opportunity with either its ranged shot or bayonet.

name: Sith Sword
description: Alchemical blade that resists lightsabers, supports Block/Deflect/Redirect Shot, and can spend a Force Point for Dark Side Score bonus damage.

name: Sling
description: Primitive ranged weapon that adds Strength to damage.

name: Slugthrower Pistol
description: Ballistic pistol using 10-round slug clips instead of power packs.

name: Slugthrower Rifle
description: Ballistic rifle using 20-round slug clips instead of power packs.

name: Grenade, Smoke
description: Two-square concealment/smoke-hazard cloud lasting 10 rounds.

name: Snap Baton
description: Collapsible baton that expands or collapses as a swift action.

name: Blaster Pistol, Snap Shot
description: Single-shot concealed pistol granting +5 to Stealth checks to conceal it.

name: Snare Pistol

name: Snare Rifle

name: Blaster Rifle, Sniper

description: One-hundred-shot sonic pistol whose attacks cannot be negated by Deflect.

name: Sonic Rifle

name: Sonic Stunner
description: Silent-to-bystanders sonic stun pistol that still affects deaf targets.

name: Spear
description: Simple piercing polearm that can also be thrown.

name: Blaster Carbine, Sporting

name: Blaster Pistol, Sporting
description: Civilian sporting sidearm using either a 6-shot energy cell or a 100-shot power pack.

name: Blaster Rifle, Sporting

name: Squib Tensor Rifle

name: Static Pike
description: Reach pike with lethal/stun settings that can also be thrown.

name: Stokhli Spray Stick
description: Long-range stun/capture weapon whose webbing also functions as a net for grab or grapple.

name: Stun Baton
description: Club that can deliver stun damage; requires an energy cell.

name: Grenade, Stun

name: Stun Pistol

name: Stunning Gauntlet

name: Subrepeating Blaster
description: Autofire-only compact blaster; extend its stock to brace it, with 50 shots per pack.

name: Survival Knife

name: Tactical Tractor Beam
description: Huge-or-smaller tractor weapon that moves or hurls grabbed objects; normally crew-served and generator-powered.

name: Targeting Blaster Rifle

name: Targeting Laser

name: Tehkla Blade

name: Thermal Detonator

name: Thud Bug

name: Gaderffii

name: Blaster Rifle, Variable

name: Verpine Shatter Gun
description: Accurate fragile Verpine handgun: +1d10 damage after critical multiplication, disabled by any weapon damage, and treated as a pistol by Verpines.

name: Vibro-Ax
description: Heavy vibro axe powered by two energy cells.

name: Vibro-Saw
description: Large vibro tool/weapon that ignores Damage Reduction; uses two energy cells.

name: Vibrobayonet
description: Powered rifle bayonet that preserves melee threat/AoO after ranged fire; detached it functions as a vibrodagger.

name: Vibroblade

name: Vibroblade, Double
description: Double vibro weapon powered by two cells; both ends can attack in a full-round action.

name: Vibrodagger
description: Small, lightly regulated vibro weapon powered by an energy cell.

name: Vibroknucklers
description: Worn vibro weapon adds +3 unarmed damage, counts as both unarmed/simple and advanced melee, and cannot be disarmed.

name: Vibrolance
description: Large reach vibro polearm dealing piercing or slashing damage.

name: Vibrorapier
description: Silent, finely balanced vibro blade powered by two energy cells.

name: Vibrosword
description: Large two-handed vibroblade powered by an energy cell.

name: Wan-Shen
description: Matukai double polearm with +1 reach that packs into four Small pieces as a full-round action.

name: War Sword
description: Heavy simple longsword with no additional special rule.

name: Ryyk Blade
description: Traditional Wookiee blade; advanced-melee-proficient Wookiees are proficient and carriers gain +2 forest/jungle survival.

name: Blaster, Wrist
description: Single-shot concealed wrist blaster that requires DC 25 Use Computer to detect with weapon sensors.

name: Wrist Rocket Launcher
description: Forearm-mounted single-shot launcher using several specialized rocket payloads.

name: Xerrol Nightstinger
description: Sniper rifle firing visually invisible shots from five-shot exotic-gas canisters.

name: Zhaboka
description: Zabrak double pike that removes Rapid Strike's attack penalty.
